crossRefs.note: because it didn’t shut up the doors of my mother’s womb, nor did it hide trouble from my eyes.
“Why didn’t I die from the womb? Why didn’t I give up the spirit when my mother bore me?
Woe is me, my mother, that you have borne me, a man of strife, and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have not…
Cursed is the day in which I was born. Don’t let the day in which my mother bore me be blessed.
The Son of Man goes, even as it is written of him, but woe to that man through whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It…
But the eyes of the wicked will fail. They will have no way to flee. Their hope will be the giving up of the spirit.”
But man dies, and is laid low. Yes, man gives up the spirit, and where is he?

translations.web: “ ‘Why, then, have you brought me out of the womb? I wish I had given up the spirit, and no eye had seen me.
translations.bsb: Why then did You bring me from the womb? Oh, that I had died, and no eye had seen me!
translations.kjv: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb? Oh that I had given up the ghost, and no eye had seen
translations.asv: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb? I had given up the ghost, and no eye had seen me.
